snippet.title: Forward to the Past : Homebrew from 2021 - on the ZX Spectrum 48K !! with Commentary
snippet.description:
FORWARD TO THE PAST - A Homebrew on the ZX Spectrum 48K. Published by Sloanysoft in 2021. Rescue Dave and Nate from certain doom by collecting those crystals I can't pronounce.  Good luck !!!   :oD

As usual, it's not about perfect game play, but easing stress, having some fun and seeing what the game would have felt like on your first or second go.
